scheme: National Livestock Mission, Entrepreneurship Development Programme: Rural Poultry
unit: Parent farm of Low Input Technology birds with hatchery and brooder-mother unit
notes: Back-ended capital subsidy in two instalments through SIDBI; not for working capital, land, land lease or personal vehicles. Layer farms only.

unit: Feed plant or meat processing unit (not the farm itself)
notes: 3% interest subvention; loan up to 90% of project cost; 8 years including 2 years moratorium; credit guarantee for MSMEs.

unit: 5,000 desi or improved layers (project Rs 30,00,000), or 3,000 or 5,000 desi or improved meat birds (Rs 12,00,000 or Rs 19,00,000)
source_document: Maharashtra GR DAHD-14017/1/2026-AH4, 9 March 2026, State Plan Scheme (unique code 202603091924368401), amended 27 August 2026 (202608271649419545)
notes: Subsidy is a share of the fixed project cost per unit; paid in two halves; 2 years of experience or training; 20 gunthe of land owned or a 5-year registered lease; 50% of places for women and 5% for people with disabilities; first come, first served since the corrigendum of 27 August 2026, which changes nothing else for poultry.

scheme: Mukhyamantri Gramin Pashudhan Udyojakta Yojana: interest subvention on a poultry loan
unit: A bank loan for a goat, sheep, cow, buffalo or poultry project, or a fodder or feed unit
source_document: Maharashtra GR DAHD-14017/1/2026-AH4, 9 March 2026, State Plan Scheme, item 5 (unique code 202603091924368401), as amended by the corrigendum of 27 August 2026 (202608271649419545)
notes: 4 percentage points off the loan's interest rate, up to Rs 4,00,000 in all, paid after the whole loan is repaid on time; only for a project with no other central or state subsidy.

scheme: Bihar: subsidy for a broiler farm of 3,000 birds (Saat Nishchay-2)
source_document: Bihar Directorate of Animal Husbandry letter 1957 of 23 May 2025, under sanction order 6 SS(6)13/2023-2195 of 20 May 2025
notes: A 3,000-bird broiler unit costs Rs 10,00,000: 30% (up to Rs 3,00,000) for general applicants, 50% (up to Rs 5,00,000) for SC/ST. Paid in one lump sum once the farm is built. The letter is hosted on the department's application portal, not a gov.in site.

scheme: Bihar: Samekit Murgi Vikas Yojana (layer farm)
source_document: Bihar Directorate of Animal Husbandry letter 1958 of 23 May 2025, under sanction order 6 SS(6)40/2014(Khand)-2200 of 20 May 2025
notes: 5,000 layers cost Rs 48,50,000 and 10,000 layers Rs 1,00,00,000; the subsidy is 30% for general applicants and 40% for SC/ST. Paid in two instalments (60% then 40%). The state also pays 50% of the bank loan's interest for 4 years.

scheme: Odisha: support to farmers for broiler farming (State Plan, 2026-27)
unit: 2000 meat birds (Rs 720000), 2500 meat birds (Rs 900000), 3000 meat birds (Rs 1080000)
source_document: Odisha Directorate of AH&VS, guidelines for broiler farming 2026-27, file PT1-AHVS-PD-MISC-0048-2025/01/2026 (May 2026)
notes: Units of 2,000, 2,500 and 3,000 birds cost Rs 7.2, 9.0 and 10.8 lakh. Paid after the work is done, in two halves.

scheme: Odisha: support to farmers for layer farming (State Plan, 2026-27)
source_document: Odisha Directorate of AH&VS, guidelines for layer farming 2026-27, file PT1-AHVS-PD-MISC-0048-2025/01/2026 (May 2026)
notes: Rs 8.225 lakh per 1,000 layers, in cages or on deep litter, for 1,000 to 4,000 birds. Paid after the work is done, in two halves.

source_document: Uttarakhand GO 1631/XV-1/22-1(15)/2022 of 15 Nov 2022, continued in 2025-26 by GO 1768/XV-1/2025/87507 of 19 Sep 2025
notes: A 500-bird unit costs Rs 3,05,100. The subsidy is a fixed Rs 60,000: Rs 15 a bird for 6 batches plus Rs 15,000 for the shed. In the 9 hill districts there is also a feed subsidy of Rs 10 a bird, up to Rs 30,000 (GO of 19 Sep 2025).

scheme: Uttarakhand Poultry Development Policy 2025 (commercial layer farm)
source_document: Uttarakhand GO 588/XV-1/25/62949 of 9 Jun 2025 (policy, to 31 Dec 2030); procedure GO 2014/XV-1/2025-93015 of 10 Oct 2025
notes: Plains: 30,000 layers, Rs 1.8 crore, 30% up to Rs 54 lakh. Hills: 15,000 layers, Rs 1.2 crore, 40% up to Rs 48 lakh. Paid 50%, 40% and 10% as the farm comes up.

scheme: Uttar Pradesh Poultry Development Policy 2022: interest reimbursement for a layer farm
source_document: Uttar Pradesh policy GO 2254/37-2-2022-1(45)/2012TC of 7 Nov 2022; implementing GO 2505/37-2-2022-1(45)/12TC of 29 Dec 2022
notes: 7% interest reimbursed for 5 years on units of 10,000, 30,000 or 60,000 caged layers (Rs 99.53, 256.69 and 491.90 lakh), up to Rs 14.61, 37.71 and 72.30 lakh.

scheme: Assam: Policy for Commercialisation of Poultry Sector 2024 (amended 2025)
source_document: Assam notification VFV.38/2024/1 of 16 Mar 2024, amended by ECF.No. 670980/60 (cited as 3 Nov 2025)
notes: 33% of the capital cost, up to Rs 5 crore, for layer farms of 50,000+ birds and broiler farms of 20,000+, paid 20/40/40 as the farm reaches 20%, 40% and 90% of capacity. Also a 3% interest subsidy on the term loan and working capital, and a power subsidy of Rs 2 a unit, within Rs 10 crore per project.

scheme: Goa: Financial Assistance for Infrastructure of Poultry 2018
source_document: Goa Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, scheme page
notes: 75% of infrastructure cost: up to Rs 6 lakh for 2,000 broilers or low-input birds, up to Rs 21 lakh for 4,000 layers on deep litter. A separate 2018 scheme pays 80% of chick cost and 20% of feed cost each month, up to Rs 56,000 for broilers and Rs 48,000 for layers.

scheme: Himachal Pradesh: Him Kukkut Palan Yojna (broiler farm)
source_document: Himachal Pradesh Department of Animal Husbandry, DBT portal: broiler establishment
notes: 60% subsidy on the capital cost of a 3,000-chick broiler unit, for all categories.

source_document: Jharkhand Directorate of Animal Husbandry, Mukhyamantri Pashudhan Vikas Yojana handbill (2025-26)
notes: A 500-chick broiler unit with shed costs Rs 67,500; a 400-chick low-input desi unit with cage Rs 1,18,200.

scheme: Tamil Nadu: 50% subsidy for a 250-bird country chicken farm
source_document: Nagapattinam District Collector press release 04 of 3 Jul 2025 (2025-26; continued in 2026-27)
notes: A 250-bird country chicken unit costs Rs 3,31,250 (shed, equipment and 4 months of feed); the subsidy is 50%, Rs 1,65,625.

scheme: Arunachal Pradesh: Atma Nirbhar Pashu Palan Yojna (poultry)
source_document: District AH & Veterinary Officer, Lohit: ANPPY 2025-26 circular of 28 Oct 2025 (memo LV/DEV/ANPPY/2025-26/313-29)
notes: A Rs 5 lakh poultry unit gets Rs 2,25,000 and a Rs 15 lakh entrepreneurship unit Rs 6,75,000, at 45%.
